summary: The comment urges schools to be transparent with parents about online content that encourages gender transition and to give parents control over such material.

claims.requested_action: Require schools to disclose and allow parental review of online content related to gender transition
claims.argument: Parents must be informed and able to decide if their children can view content that encourages gender transition or medical interventions.
